# OSR - Professorship for Open-Source Software at FAU

> Academic research and education hub for open-source software at Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg, led by Prof. Dr. Dirk Riehle.

The OSR (Open-Source Research) group at FAU's Department of Computer Science focuses on research, teaching, and community engagement in open-source software. The professorship is located in Erlangen and conducts interdisciplinary work bridging academia and industry.

## Key Topics

- Open-Source Software
- Prof. Dr. Dirk Riehle
- Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU)
- Erlangen
- Research
- Education
- Software Engineering
- Community
- Academic Professorship
